title: Skill-Composer: Requirement-Driven Skill Selection from Multiple Marketplaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.30715v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent skills have become the primary vehicle through which agents reuse specialized capabilities, yet public skill marketplaces provide skills with individual items: a query, whether matched through keyword or embedding similarity, returns a list of single skills ordered by relevance or by popularity. Such an interface cannot answer the question a developer actually faces: which set of skills should be installed to cover a task's complete requirement? The highest-ranked skills are often functionally redundant, while capabilities that are genuinely required remain uncovered. In this paper, we argue that skill acquisition should be reframed from ranking to set selection. We propose Skill-Composer, an agent-native framework that selects a non-redundant skill bundle for the user requirement, which aims to cover all available required capabilities and report any gaps. Specifically, it clarifies user requirements into atomic requirement points

translated_title: Skill-Composer：基于需求驱动的多市场技能选择
translated_abstract: 代理技能已成为代理复用专业能力的主要载体，然而公共技能市场提供的技能均以单项形式呈现：无论通过关键词还是嵌入相似度进行匹配，查询返回的都是一个按相关性或流行度排序的单项技能列表。这样的交互方式无法回答开发者实际面临的问题：应该安装哪一组技能才能覆盖任务的完整需求？排名最高的技能往往在功能上相互冗余，而真正需要的能力却可能未被覆盖。在本文中，我们主张将技能获取从“排序”重新定义为“集合选择”问题。我们提出了Skill-Composer，一个面向代理的原生框架，它针对用户需求选择一个非冗余的技能组合，旨在覆盖所有可用的所需能力并报告任何缺口。具体而言，它将用户需求澄清为原子需求点。
tldr: 该论文提出Skill-Composer框架，将技能获取从单项技能排序重新定义为集合选择问题，通过将用户需求分解为原子需求点，从多个技能市场中选择非冗余的技能组合以完整覆盖任务需求并报告能力缺口。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Skill-Composer, an agent-native framework that reframes skill acquisition from ranking to set selection, decomposing user requirements into atomic requirement points to select a non-redundant skill bundle from multiple marketplaces that fully covers task requirements and reports capability gaps.
